text:
leo: FYI ran into duplicated vectors during onboarding. node SDK retried on 429 and we got two inserts for the same doc id.

carla: which endpoint and SDK version? any chance you're reusing the same request object across retries?

leo: /v1/embeddings, node @ 0.11.1. we create new request each time but payload hasn't idempotency key. sample log: ```ERROR 429 rate_limit
DEBUG retry=1 backoff=400ms
DEBUG retry=2 backoff=800ms
INFO 200 id=vec_99```

nik: thanks. this is classic safe-replay problem — embeddings aren't natively idempotent unless the client provides a per-logical-request key the server can use to dedupe. SDK should help here.

carla: agree. options: (A) add a first-class Idempotency-Key header for embeddings on the API (server change), (B) SDK auto-add x-redwood-client-id when user passes idempotencyKey option, or (C) recommend server-side dedupe in ingestion.

leo: (B) would unblock customers quickly. (A) requires API design and rollout.

nik: proposed SDK behavior: default maxRetries=0 for parity, recommended snippet in README sets maxRetries=2 with jittered exp backoff (base=150ms, cap=2000ms, jitter=0..120ms). SDK should generate RFC4122 UUID v4 per logical request when user does not supply explicit idempotencyKey. header name: `Idempotency-Key`.

carla: small safety note: some Dedicated deployments use strict replay semantics; defaulting to auto-idempotency could hide bugs. So keep default off, but log a one-time warning recommending idempotency for embedding workloads.

leo: sample helper I used: ```js
function sendEmbeddings(items, opts={}){
  const id = opts.idempotencyKey || uuidv4();
  return client.embeddings.create({input: items, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id }})
}
```

nik: also add an SDK-level `retryHook` so platform customers can plug in custom dedupe hooks (e.g., attach request fingerprint).

carla: I'll open a small PR that: 1) adds Idempotency-Key option to SDK client ctor, 2) wires jitter util into retry stack, 3) documents recommended config and Dedicated caveat, 4) adds an examples/embeddings-safe-replay repro app.

ops-bot: CI: lint/2049 running. unit/retry-utils.test flaky on timeouts; scheduled rerun.

leo: thanks. +1 for the sample app. I'll attach our minimal repro (200 lines) to the PR — it reproduces 429 -> duplicate insert without idempotency header.

nik: for the server side, we should consider accepting Idempotency-Key for embeddings too; ops can make it optional and use a short TTL keyed-store to dedupe. That avoids changing client responsibilities.

carla: noted. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime on server acceptance and storage cost. For now, SDK patch will give immediate relief to onboarding customers.

leo: if you add an onboarding doc note: "If you see duplicate embeddings during retries, enable idempotency-key or implement server-side dedupe" that will help CS triage.
